name: desk-look
description: Claude Code mod that redraws the terminal transcript to look like the Code tab of the Claude desktop app: prompt bubbles, markdown tables, mermaid diagrams, folded tool calls, agent cards, plan card, a progress band of the current step and what runs now, GitHub/GitLab PR bar, diff, activity, context, background tasks and Markdown preview panes. The Asana and Slack panes are the separate desk-asana and desk-slack plugins

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of desk-look's own labels. auto follows Claude Code's language setting in /config (Korean when it names Korean, English otherwise)

bubbleSide.title: Prompt bubble side
bubbleSide.description: Put your prompt bubble on the left (aligned with the engine's attachment lines) or on the right (like the desktop app)

contextChip.title: Context chip
contextChip.description: The context usage chip next to the band above the prompt (click it for the breakdown pane): auto shows it from 50%, always always shows it, off hides it

bandAfterTurn.title: Progress band after the turn
bandAfterTurn.description: How long the progress band above the prompt stays once the turn ends, its last step marked done (close it early with ✕). off folds it as soon as the turn ends, keep leaves it until you close it or the next turn starts

askNotify.title: Question notification
askNotify.description: Send a notification when a question or plan card opens (the same channel the engine dialog uses, preferredNotifChannel). off turns it off

prBar.title: PR bar
prBar.description: The pull request chip next to the band above the prompt (click it for the /desk-pr pane). Reads GitHub with gh and GitLab with glab. off turns it off

previewAutoOpen.title: Preview new documents
previewAutoOpen.description: Open a Markdown document Claude writes in the preview pane when the turn ends (files under .claude/ never open by themselves). off leaves it to the ◫ chip and /desk-preview

replyInBlocks.title: Replies by block
replyInBlocks.description: Hold Claude's reply text until a block (the text between tool calls) is complete and show it at once, instead of streaming it a few lines at a time. A block taller than the screen comes out whole too, so scroll up to read its start. When your last prompt came from the Claude app (Remote Control), the reply streams as usual, since the app receives the same stream. off streams as Claude Code does
